message.content: {"title":"exp-B12-bottleneck: Emergent Behavior & Causal Relationships","narrative":"The provided evidence includes only the model specification and run metadata; no aggregated time series or occupancy statistics are available to analyze the dynamics quantitatively. Without snapshots or time‐series data on zone occupancies, flow rates through the 1.2 m door and corridor, or evacuated counts over time, we cannot confirm where and when congestion emerged or how the evacuation unfolded step by step. Consequently, emergent patterns such as queuing at the bottleneck, oscillatory release through the door, or phase transitions from free flow to jammed conditions cannot be substantiated from the given information.","key_findings":[],"causal_links":[],"emergent_phenomena":[]}
